declarations.docstring: A finite additive commutative group is subsingleton if every homomorphism from it to a finite additive commutative group lifts along every surjective homomorphism between finite additive commutative groups.

A module over a polynomial ring that is finite-dimensional over the coefficient field is subsingleton if every polynomial-linear map from it to another such module lifts along every surjective polynomial-linear map between such modules.
A finite module over a commutative ring of finite type over the integers admits a surjective linear map from a finite free module.
